name: shadow-sweep-text
title: Shadow Sweep Text
description: A rising line is uncovered and removed by two dense dark shadow sweeps.
useWhen: A short statement should emerge through a dense shadow instead of fading or clipping into view.
The text rises on a subtle diagonal while the reveal travels across the line, then the shadow takes it away.
avoidWhen: The text should stay visible after entering: use mask-reveal-up for a one-way reveal.
Each word needs its own entrance timing: use per-word-crossfade or centered-word-build.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Short statement revealed and removed by the shadow.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Color of the field behind the text.

variables.label: Shadow color
variables.description: Color of the sweeping shadow. Match it to the background.

variables.label: Shadow softness
variables.description: Width of the soft edge in pixels.

variables.label: Rise
variables.description: How far below its place the text starts.

variables.label: Drift left
variables.description: How far right of its place the text starts.
